default.notes: A free 30-day visitor entry permit is issued on arrival to citizens of essentially every country — bring a passport valid six months and a confirmed onward ticket. Extensions are granted by the FSM Division of Immigration.

FM.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for citizens of the Federated States of Micronesia.

US.notes: Under the Compact of Free Association, US citizens may enter, live and work in the FSM without a visa or time limit — a valid passport is still required at the border.

MH.notes: Marshallese citizens enter freely under the reciprocal arrangements between the Compact states — confirm current residence and work rules with FSM immigration for stays beyond a visit.

PW.notes: Palauan citizens enter freely under the reciprocal arrangements between the Compact states — confirm current residence and work rules with FSM immigration for stays beyond a visit.
